work.description: A structured 6-step methodology from PT. Global Inmarco Sejahtera to ensure every project is measurable, professional, and delivers real impact.

steps.title: UNDERSTAND
steps.subtitle: Understanding Needs
steps.description: Exploring the needs, goals, challenges, and unique characteristics of your organization or company.

steps.title: ANALYZE
steps.subtitle: Data Analysis
steps.description: Gathering information and analyzing relevant data in depth to establish the foundation of the strategy.

steps.title: STRATEGIZE
steps.subtitle: Concept Planning
steps.description: Formulating measurable strategies, communication architecture, and innovative campaign and execution ideas.

steps.title: EXECUTE
steps.subtitle: Program Execution
steps.description: Executing programs with precision, backed by experienced personnel and integrated technology.

steps.title: MONITOR
steps.subtitle: Quality Supervision
steps.description: Conducting regular supervision throughout implementation to ensure service quality stays optimal.

steps.title: EVALUATE
steps.subtitle: Evaluation & Recommendations
steps.description: Comprehensive evaluation and strategic recommendations for sustainable business development.
